svg.title: Architecture overview — the main classes and how they connect
svg.desc: One box per key class (members hidden). Read top to bottom: a browser frame enters the TcpServer, passes the RequestPipeline, reaches a handler + service, changes a GameRoom, and a finished game is saved by GameCompletionService. Diagrams 02–08 zoom in.
svg.text: Architecture overview — the main classes and how they connect
One box per key class (members hidden). Read top to bottom: a browser frame enters the TcpServer, passes the RequestPipeline,
reaches a handler + service, changes a GameRoom, and a finished game is saved by GameCompletionService. Diagrams 02–08 zoom in.
<<interface>> = abstract class with only pure virtual methods; <<abstract>> = has some.
